title: "Shards of Truth"
next_chapter_hook: "The hidden page of the Tianji Record slowly unfurled. When the ancient inscription came into view, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—the true breaking point was hidden within the death ritual of Chapter 700 itself."

text.content: "Inside the Crown Prince's bedchamber, candlelight flickered. Chen Ji stood in the shadows, the token he had found in the Crown Prince's secret chamber clutched in his hand—on its reverse side was clearly engraved a closed eye. That was no ordinary family emblem, but the mark of some forbidden organization from ancient times. 'Interesting.' Chen Ji flipped the token over, his fingertips tracing the nearly invisible patterns along its edge, 'The one who insisted on breaking off our engagement back then... was connected to this.' Memories from fifteen years ago surged like a tide—that family which had kicked him when he was at his lowest, shattering him from genius to废物—now, upon closer look, that broken engagement was never simply a matter of despising poverty, but a carefully orchestrated game of elimination."

"He closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record Fragment pulsed with heat in the depths of his consciousness. That familiar power surged forth—the ability to glimpse three hours into the future activated once more. Blurred images flashed like a shattered bronze mirror: the Crown Prince kneeling before some altar, and standing above the altar... that face, Chen Ji would never forget. 'So that's how it is.' He opened his eyes, a cold sneer curling his lips, 'Fifteen years ago you stole my engagement, fifteen years later you want to steal my life.' The Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently, and an unprecedented stream of information pierced his Mental Sea like a blade—the token left by Chen Xuan was resonating with the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: "From within the token, an aged voice emerged, carrying the vicissitudes of a thousand years: 'Since the bearer has arrived here, the seal on the seventh page of the Tianji Record... is hereby lifted.' That voice was the residual soul guardian left by Chen Xuan—Mo Xiansheng. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his Brow Center as the Tianji Record turned of its own accord, and the hidden information from the seventh page flooded into his consciousness like a deluge. Not text, but images—a massive chessboard covering the entire continent, and upon that board, every thousand years a piece was pushed into the abyss."

text.content: "'This is... the Chess Game of Fate.' Chen Ji murmured, his voice trembling slightly. Those images were too shocking—he saw the Tianji Record bearers of all ages, watched them walk toward death one after another, and with each death, a beam of light descended from the heavens, injecting into some unnameable existence. 'A perfect death every thousand years...' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more, 'This is the foundation that sustains the Heavenly Eye. Without perfect death, it sleeps; once it sleeps, the rules collapse, and heaven and earth fall into chaos.' Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, his knuckles white. So the so-called Tianji Record was not some reverse-heavenly opportunity, but a meticulously designed... sacrifice selector."

dialogue.content: "'So I was never a chess piece.' Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried bone-deep coldness, 'I am the sacrifice.' He suddenly laughed—that smile was more pitiful than crying. Fourteen years of scheming, fourteen years of endurance, fourteen years of playing the fool to devour the mighty—ultimately, he thought himself the Chess Player, only to discover he had been a discarded piece waiting to be pushed into the abyss from the very start. The seal on the eighth page of the Tianji Record loosened at this moment, and more information coiled upward like venomous snakes: Chen Ji's death must be 'perfect,' with no hatred, no regrets, no accidents—he must die willingly to provide the Heavenly Eye with the purest nourishment."

text.content: "'Perfect death...' Chen Ji chewed on these four characters, then suddenly recalled something, 'So all those previous Tianji Record bearers were designed this way?' Mo Xiansheng offered no answer, but that silence itself was the answer. Perhaps they too had rebelled, but ultimately all walked the same ending—not killed, but driven into a corner by fate itself, willingly sacrificing themselves. 'Chen Xuan...' Chen Ji whispered that name, 'Did he leave this token to make me repeat his fate, or to give me a chance to break the局?' The token suddenly burned scalding hot, and new information surfaced: 'Chapter 700, the Convergence Point of Fate.'"

"Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Chapter 700—it was not a mere chapter number, but the 'moment of fate's convergence' recorded on the first page of the complete Tianji Record. At this moment, all causal threads of past and future would briefly overlap, and the center of that overlap was the Tianji Record bearer himself. 'So that's how it is.' He murmured, 'The death in Chapter 700 is not ordinary death, but the climax of a sacrifice ritual.' But just as he was about to fully comprehend this, a thought flashed through his mind like lightning—if the ritual requires 'perfect death,' then what if the death itself is imperfect? What if at the final moment, a variable appears that the designers did not anticipate?"

choice.prompt: "The hidden information of the Tianji Record flooded entirely into his Mental Sea, and Chen Ji finally saw the framework of his fate. But having seen the framework, he must now make a choice—to obey this thousand-year rule, or to shatter it with his own hands?"

choices.description: "Since perfect death is the loophole, then create imperfection. The Tianji Record requires a willing sacrifice—then let it receive one filled with hatred, resentment, and fury."
choices.visible_reward: "The First Step to Breaking the Thousand-Year Sacrifice Cycle"
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Eye will surely backlash—this is a direct confrontation with the Heavenly Dao"
choices.process_label: 陈机决定逆转命运规则

text.content: "There was fire burning in Chen Ji's eyes. That was no flame of rage, but a cold,理智的、足以焚尽一切的业火。'What a fine thousand-year sacrifice.' He murmured softly, 'Since you want perfect death, I shall give you a variable it can never digest.' The Tianji Record shuddered violently, as if sensing his resolve. Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged, carrying a barely perceptible tremor: 'Have you thought this through? This path... no one has ever walked it.'"

dialogue.content: "'No one has ever walked it?' Chen Ji laughed—that smile was cold enough to chill the heart, 'Then I shall be the first.' His voice was soft, yet carried unwavering resolve, 'Chen Ji, every step I have taken on this road—which one was walked by predecessors?' The seals on the Tianji Record loosened completely at this moment, and unprecedented power flooded into his body—the accumulated grievances of all past bearers, the unspoken roars of every sacrificed soul. Thousand-year rules... it is time to rewrite them."

choices.description: "Utilize all abilities of the Tianji Record, bringing all variables under control before Chapter 700 arrives. Not to destroy the rules, but to become the rules themselves."
choices.visible_cost: "Consuming a Large Amount of Heavenly Fate Value"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtaining Core Information to Rewrite the Rules"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate Value reaching zero will cause the foresight ability to be permanently lost"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not make a decision immediately. His mind raced at high speed, arranging and combining all information. Thousand-year sacrifice, Heavenly Eye, perfect death... these fragments gradually assembled into a complete picture in his mind. 'If I can find that core...' he murmured, 'Not to destroy the rules, but to rewrite them.' The Tianji Record shuddered again, and this time it seemed to respond to his thoughts. New information surfaced—the core of the Heavenly Eye lies deep within the Forbidden Grounds jointly guarded by the three great sects."

dialogue.content: "'You want to touch the core?' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a note of warning, 'That thing... is not something mortals can endure.' Chen Ji laughed instead, that smile carrying a hint of madness, 'Mortals? From the moment I stepped onto this path, I was no longer mortal.' He raised his hand, pressing the token onto the cover of the Tianji Record. In an instant, brilliant light burst from his palm, and all seals on the Tianji Record broke completely—not passively, but forcibly broken open by him. 'From this moment forward, I am no longer the bearer of the Tianji Record.' His voice echoed through his Mental Sea, 'I am the Tianji Record itself.'"

choices.description: "Summon all forces opposing fate—the Demonic Path Saintess Ye Qing, Su Qingyao, even the old Sect Master Ling Yuan—join hands to unleash a storm sufficient to shake Heavenly Dao."
choices.visible_reward: "Gaining key allies to oppose the Heavenly Eye"
choices.risk_hint: "There may be spies of the Heavenly Eye among the allies"
choices.process_label: 陈机决定联合所有力量

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingers gently tapping the edge of the token. He was summoning—not with Spiritual Energy, but using some ancient ritual recorded in the Tianji Record Fragment. After a moment, demonic energy seeped from the Void, taking the form of a alluring face—it was none other than the Demonic Path Saintess Ye Qing. 'Chen Ji?' Ye Qing's voice carried surprise, 'You actually contacted me proactively?' Chen Ji skipped pleasantries, directly projecting the information about the thousand-year sacrifice from the Tianji Record to her."

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing's expression froze completely after seeing that information. After a long while, she let out a sharp cold laugh: 'What a fine Heavenly Eye, what a fine perfect death... so the sacrifices of my Demonic Path Saintesses through the ages were also your doing.' Her voice carried deep-seated hatred, 'I thought the Holy Sect using me was cruel enough, but the true mastermind was this so-called Heavenly Dao.' Chen Ji looked at her, his voice calm: 'Ye Qing, I need your Demonic Path Miasma to conceal Heavenly Secrets aura. At the same time, I need you to contact everyone who has been toyed with by Heavenly Dao—I want this storm to sweep across the entire continent.'"

text.content: "Just as various forces stirred darkly due to Chen Ji's summons, the Tianji Record displayed yet another piece of information sealed under many layers. That was the final record left by Chen Xuan before his death, written in a long-lost ancient script—ordinary people could not read it, but Chen Ji could decipher every character perfectly. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out at this moment, carrying a fluctuation it had never shown in a thousand years: 'This is... his final instructions to me.' Chen Ji listened quietly, and a dust-shrouded truth slowly unfolded."

"'The Heavenly Eye is not invincible.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was low, 'A thousand years ago, the first Tianji Record bearer did not die from sacrifice, but from... betrayal.' Chen Ji's pupils constricted violently. Betrayal? According to the text on the Tianji Record Fragment, after the first bearer discovered the secret of perfect death, he attempted to pass this loophole to later bearers, but every attempt at communication ended in accidental death. 'Until Chen Xuan.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a slight tremor, 'He is the only person who survived the sacrifice ritual—by deliberately making his death imperfect.'"

dialogue.content: "'Chen Xuan didn't die?' Chen Ji pressed, his voice carrying disbelief. Mo Xiansheng's residual soul image materialized—a weary and exhausted figure: 'He did not die, but he paid the price—he lost all abilities of the Tianji Record, becoming a mortal. More importantly, he discovered something.' Mo Xiansheng paused,似乎在组织语言，'The core of the Heavenly Eye is not unshakeable. It has a fatal weakness—it needs perfect death to sustain itself, but if three consecutive sacrifices fail... it will fall into a thousand-year slumber.' Chen Ji looked up sharply: 'Three times? I'm only Chapter 700... what happened to the previous six hundred and ninety-nine bearers?'"

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji discovered an earth-shattering secret—the Heavenly Eye needs three failed sacrifices to fall into slumber. But the question remains: what became of the fates of those six hundred and ninety-nine predecessors? He must investigate this buried history."

choices.description: "Employ all perceptive abilities of the Tianji Record, tracing the fate trajectories of the previous six hundred and ninety-nine bearers, uncovering the truth behind their deaths."
choices.visible_cost: "Consuming a Large Amount of Mental Energy"
choices.process_label: 陈机开始追溯历史真相

text.content: "Chen Ji sat cross-legged, the Tianji Record slowly unfurling before him. Those yellowed pages began to glow, and countless images flashed through his mind like a carousel. The previous six hundred and ninety-nine bearers... their faces, their struggles, their deaths, all presented before his eyes. Each person had tried to resist, but each was suppressed by some force at the final moment—not by Heavenly Dao itself, but by... another bearer."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, cold sweat drenching his body. He saw it! Among the previous six hundred and ninety-nine bearers, more than half did not die from sacrifice, but from being killed by... later bearers. 'This is impossible...' he murmured, 'Why?' Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged, carrying deep bitterness: 'Because the Tianji Record has a hidden rule—when a bearer dies and the death is imperfect, all the Heavenly Fate Value they accumulated transfers to the next bearer. These people... they were not killed by Heavenly Dao, but harvested by their successors.' A wave of nausea washed over Chen Ji. So the so-called inheritance was always a massacre."

choices.description: "Since Chen Xuan is the only person who survived the sacrifice, he must still be alive. Chen Ji needs to find him and ask for the key to breaking fate."
choices.risk_hint: "Chen Xuan May Have Been Controlled by the Heavenly Eye"

text.content: "'Where is Chen Xuan?' Chen Ji asked directly. Mo Xiansheng paused for a moment, his residual soul image flickering unsteadily: 'He... is right by your side.' Chen Ji was stunned, then suddenly remembered something. He retrieved from his chest the Jade Pendant he had always carried close—something he had捡到in the ruins, originally thinking it merely an ordinary keepsake. 'This Jade Pendant...' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried complex emotions, 'is what Chen Xuan left for you.' The Jade Pendant suddenly shattered, and from within emerged a phantom figure—a young man with features somewhat similar to Chen Ji's, but with more weathering between his brows."

dialogue.content: "'I have waited for you a long time.' Chen Xuan's voice carried exhaustion and relief, 'You are stronger and smarter than I imagined.' Chen Ji stared at him, asking in a low voice: 'What is the key to breaking fate?' Chen Xuan smiled faintly, that smile carrying a thousand years of沉淀: 'You already know the loophole of perfect death, but there is an even simpler method—find the core of the Heavenly Eye, and before it awakens next, seal it completely with three imperfect deaths.' He paused, 'And right now, you are the third.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji looked at the phantom before him, and suddenly understood something. 'The first is me, the second is Chen Nian, the third is...' Chen Xuan nodded, his voice carrying a trace of apology: 'The third was supposed to be me, but you appeared.' He raised his hand, pointing in a certain direction behind Chen Ji, 'Go see her. For fifteen years, she has been waiting for you.' Chen Ji spun around, and within the shattered Void, a familiar figure emerged—his long-missing sister, Chen Nian. She was bound by countless chains, and the source of those chains pointed directly toward some forbidden place above the heavens."

"'Nian'er!' Chen Ji's voice lost its composure for the first time, carrying heart-wrenching urgency. Chen Nian seemed to sense something, slowly turning her head. Her face was pale as paper, but those eyes were still bright—when she saw Chen Ji, tears poured out. 'Brother...' her voice was weak yet clear, 'I knew you would come.' Chen Ji's fists clenched until his knuckles cracked—the runes on those chains he recognized—they were sealing techniques from the Tianji Record. 'So that's how it is.' He murmured, his voice chillingly cold, 'The Heavenly Fate Lock-Key... you turned Nian'er into the lock sealing the Heavenly Eye's core.'"

"Chen Xuan's phantom began to fade, but his voice remained clear: 'Chen Ji, my time is running out. Listen to me—Chen Nian is the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, but she did not become the lock willingly. As long as you can find her before Chapter 700, and get her to willingly release the lock's binding... the Heavenly Eye's core will be exposed.' He paused, 'And at that time, what you need is not perfect death, but a perfect... rebellion.' As his words fell, Chen Xuan's phantom dissolved completely, transforming into scattered light that merged into the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of excitement: 'Master, Chen Xuan's information has been completely transferred to you. The hidden pages of the complete Tianji Record... are now appearing.'"

"The pages of the Tianji Record began to flip frantically, and those originally blurred hidden messages emerged one by one. Chen Ji's pupils reflected countless ancient characters, each line seeming to whisper an earth-shattering secret. 'So the true breaking point...' he murmured, his voice carrying disbelief and joy, 'does not lie in perfect death, but in—Chapter 700 itself is a sacrifice ritual, but the one being sacrificed is not the Heavenly Eye, but all the chess pieces it has manipulated.' He looked up abruptly, gazing toward that invisible eye above the heavens, 'This time, I shall make the Heavenly Eye the sacrifice.' The final page of the Tianji Record slowly appeared, containing only a single line of text, yet sufficient to overturn the entire world's understanding—that was the final testament written by Chen Xuan with his life, and also the key to breaking the thousand-year fate."
